description.en: Treated the magnitude scale as linear, e.g. dividing energy by a constant instead of applying the logarithm.
description.et: Käsitles magnituudiskaalat lineaarsena, nt jagades energiat konstandiga, selle asemel et rakendada logaritmi.

description.en: Computed the logarithm of the energy but forgot to subtract the 4.8 offset before dividing by 1.5.
description.et: Arvutas energia logaritmi, kuid unustas enne 1.5-ga jagamist lahutada 4.8 nihke.

description.en: Used the natural logarithm (ln) instead of the base-10 logarithm the formula requires.
description.et: Kasutas naturaallogaritmi (ln) baas-10 logaritmi asemel, mida valem nõuab.
